verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair question for an online government e-services portal like e-FRRO, which could notify subscribers of application status changes, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers the front door serving a script-only application shell and a legacy entry URL returning 404. Nothing shows registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or any event subscription mechanism.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
